# HexxlaDB compatibility fixtures

The compressed primary and WAL were generated through the public API of
unmodified HexxlaDB `v0.7.1-0.20261109154236-177f2a3854b9` (commit
`177f2a3854b9eba5ce2a22ebcb69fb034eb1d8e3`). They contain one fact at `(0,0)`
and its two-dimensional embedding, committed together and closed normally.
They exercise current header checksums, framed WAL, and derived index metadata.

From the Mosaic repository root, with that exact dependency selected:

```sh
go run ./internal/adapter/secondary/hexxlastore/testdata/generate.go
go test -run '^TestCurrentHexxlaRecoverySetCompatibility$' ./internal/adapter/secondary/hexxlastore
```

The generator refuses other versions or replacements, uses a private temporary
database, caps each fixture at 1 MiB, and removes temporary files. Transaction
timestamps can change regenerated bytes. No user database is read.

The compatibility test fails with the former `v0.7.0` dependency because that
version cannot read the fixture's derived index metadata. With the current pin,
it verifies initial search, adapter writes, close/reopen, and subsequent search.
